title: A surface counterexample to Shafarevich holomorphic convexity
summary: We construct a smooth connected projective complex surface whose universal cover is not holomorphically convex. This disproves the Shafarevich conjecture on holomorphic convexity in complex dimension two.
family_title: Shafarevich counterexamples in dimension two and with large fundamental group

review.reason: Constructs a projective complex surface whose universal cover is not holomorphically convex.
